episodes.title: Rock Solid Man - Episode 001
episodes.summary: Rock Solid Man exists to call men back to the foundation — Jesus Christ. We help men build unshakable strength — physically, mentally, and spiritually. Through proven strategies, expert guidance, and a community of iron-sharpening-iron brother…
